description: Named cases for contrastive prompt evaluation (scripts/compare_prompts.py, D036). The ids and strata are reusable for any candidate; 'expected' is the verdict the Product-article rule of prompt v1.11.0 gives the named brand, chosen by reading the article, and is re-read if that rule changes. Gray-zone cases carry none and are reported, not scored. A case whose article is the source of a quoted prompt example names the quote ('prompt_example') and is kept out of accuracy; the harness also flags any other title that matches a quote in the candidate prompt.
